data.name: Clan & Flood
data.detailed_description:
From Camp to Kingdom

Start with a small clan of a dozen people. Cultivate rice paddies, build houses, grow your population. Step by step, from camp to village, from village to city-state, and finally to a kingdom of tens of thousands — witness the birth of a civilization.

Battle Against the Flood

Year after year, floods swallow the land, drowning fields, destroying homes, claiming lives. This is an epic struggle between man and nature — no end, only perseverance. Can you lead your people through another rainy season?

Reshape Nature

The flood is your enemy; the terrain is your ally. Build platforms to escape the water, construct dams to protect your home, plan your village on the rolling hills — shape survival with your own hands.

Win Hearts and Minds

Your people are not obedient tools. They have needs — food, shelter, belonging, ambition. Satisfy them, earn loyalty; ignore them, face betrayal. Every resource allocation is a choice.

Legacy Across Generations

The clan leader will grow old. Pass the throne to the capable, or to your own blood? Talent, loyalty, ambition — every succession is a gamble. Your choice determines the fate of civilization.

Features

1. From Camp to Kingdom: Lead a small clan to build a kingdom of tens of thousands

2. Battle Against the Flood: An epic struggle year after year — no end, only perseverance

3. Reshape Nature: Build platforms, construct dams, shape your home on rugged terrain

4. Win Hearts and Minds: Meet your people's diverse needs — earn loyalty or face betrayal

5. Legacy Across Generations: Meritocracy or bloodline? Every succession is a gamble

data.short_description: Flood. Famine. Betrayal. In ancient times, you lead a small clan to survive in the mud. Build shelters, cultivate fields, construct dams — but the real challenge isn't just nature: your followers have their own ambitions, and your heir may not be who you hoped. The next flood is coming.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660, Radeon R7 370 or equivalent with 2 GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 3060 with 8 GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
